name: Russian Twist
steps: Sit with knees bent and feet on the floor, or anchored for support.
Lean back slightly with a straight back, hands clasped in front of your chest.
Turn your shoulders to one side, bringing your hands beside your hip.
Return to the middle and turn to the other side.
cues: Rotate from the ribs, not just arms

common_mistakes.fix: Sit taller and lean back less
Turn the whole upper body with the hands
Slow down and pause on each side
